text: The authors state task decomposition could be fundamentally limiting because it assumes separate parts of the task can be completed independently, which may not hold for books (e.g. details only later revealed as important). They give a Pride and Prejudice example where a leaf summary misreads a request for a dance as a marriage proposal because each summary sees only local context.
title: Task decomposition assumes parts can be done independently; local context errors
